03Your setup

The quickest way: in MeshOptimiser press Ctrl , to open Settings, choose About, press Copy details, and paste below. The boxes under it fill in by themselves.

Use it on the computer where the problem happens. It only fills boxes that are empty.

Settings, About

Settings, Performance

Printed by the launcher

04Logs and messages

Paste text into the box, or drop a .txt or .log file below it. Keep long logs whole: the plain-text send cuts them short, the .zip keeps every word.

When a STEP conversion fails, its progress card has a Copy log button.

The black window on Windows, the Terminal on a Mac. On Windows: right-click its title bar, choose Edit, then Select All, press Enter, and paste. On a Mac: select the text and press Cmd C.

In the app, press Console at the bottom right and use its copy button.

05Pictures and recordings

    06The model

    A problem with a file is easiest to fix with the file. It is yours: it is only added if you add it here, and the Send button never carries it. Only the .zip does.

      A shared folder or a transfer link. Make sure it is open for at least two weeks.

      When you cannot share the file, this is what makes up for it.

      07How to reach you optional

      Only used to answer this report. Without it there is no way to ask a question, so a report that needs one may wait.
